name: Reinhard Tristan Eugen Heydrich
original_name: ラインハルト・トリスタン・オイゲン・ハイドリヒ
source:
The leader of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. Originally a high-ranking official in Germany, regarded as highly dangerous due to his seemingly boundless talent in all fields. Later, he bowed out of the public eye through the guise of a staged assassination, and formed the Obsidian Round Table alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url].

Their subordinate members acted behind the scenes of WW2 and kept on destroying friend and foe alike. His acts of destruction reached their climax during the fall of Berlin. However, he and his three direct subordinates disappeared shortly afterwards, leaving their current whereabouts a mystery.

"You would do well not to disappoint me."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1986219362/dies-irae-english-localization-project-commences/description]Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page[/url]]
translation:
隆基努斯十三骑士团的首领。他原本是德国的高官，因为在各个领域都拥有近乎无穷的才能而被视为极度危险。后来，他假借一场刺杀淡出公众视野，并与[url=https://vndb.org/c28998]墨丘利乌斯[/url]共同组建了黑曜石圆桌。

他们的部下在第二次世界大战幕后行动，不断摧毁敌我双方。他的破坏行为在柏林陷落时达到顶峰。然而，不久之后，他和三名直属部下便一同消失，当前下落成谜。

“你最好别让我失望。”
